newsitem.title: UK: Sears sells some shoe retail concessions.
newsitem.headline: Sears sells some shoe retail concessions.

text.p: British retail group Sears Plc said on Friday it had sold part of its department store shoe concession business to The Shoe Studio Group, a subsidiary of Nine West Group Inc.
Sears said it expected to sell around 65 concessions and receive total cash proceeds of 9.0 million stg for net assets of 11 million.
Sears said it expected to complete the sale at the end of August.
The company said it was continuing talks with other parties on the sale of the remaining concessions.
Sears said any concessions remaining unsold after those discussions would be closed at the end of January next year.

"We are optimistic that current discussions with other parties will lead to further disposals of concessions as going concerns. We wish to protect as many jobs as possible," chairman Bob Reid said in a statement.
